# Fixture — Phase 0 scorecard

Domain: logistics
Overall: 6.8 / 10 — proceed-with-guards
Lattice jobs: dispatch, reroute, scan
Entities: tech, job, jobs, parts
Constraints: same-day, offline

- Technical feasibility: 3/10 — Typed contracts + sequential graph.
- Scale headroom: 9/10 — Stateless workers + durable checkpoints.
- Security posture: 7/10 — Scheduler Δ0.
- API / rate-limit risk: 7/10 — Live-tool Δ1.
- Delivery confidence: 8/10 — Phased graph prevents skipped work.

## Bottlenecks
- Long-running tools must stream over WebSocket MCP.
- HITL rejection without a qualitative note is illegal.
- Constraint: same-day
- Constraint: offline

## Attack vectors
- Prompt injection via ingested competitor pages.
- Tool-call privilege escalation if OAuth scopes are inherited.
- Sandbox escape if generated exec has network.

## Recommended libraries
- TanStack Start: Typed app shell and file routes
- Zod: Schema lock on generated artifacts
- Geo/dispatch SDK: Same-day routing + ETA
- Sync engine + local cache: Offline-first writes

artifacts.title: Dispatcher topology
artifacts.body:
root_coordinator
  ├─ intent.LlmAgent          (classify + tool select)
  ├─ workflow.sequential      (phase lock 0→12)
  ├─ workflow.parallel        (research || schema)
  ├─ workflow.loop            (test → refactor)
  └─ failover.LiteLLM         (target architecture — live LLM backend: DeepSeek, E-14)

transfer_to_agent allowed only when:
  • current phase status = complete | awaiting_hitl

Runtime: sync-template

Authorization

  • Secrets never enter the isolate — proxy tokens only

Implementation today: Engine-template runner (bounded, engine-authored code only) — policy above is the P4 declaration (B-18 honesty).

Rejection policy: qualitative feedback is mandatory.
Diagnostics: one JSON event per orchestration step.
